title: Parameter Constraint Optimization Completeness
description: Current parameter constraints may not capture all physical requirements, potentially allowing unphysical solutions to pass validation.
impact: Could approve warp bubble designs that violate unknown physical constraints

title: Constraint Conflict Resolution
description: Multiple physical constraints may be mutually incompatible, requiring trade-off strategies that are not well-defined or validated.
impact: May not be able to find solutions satisfying all physical requirements simultaneously

title: Constraint Tolerance Specification
description: Tolerance bounds for constraint satisfaction are set without rigorous justification and may be too loose or too strict for physical realism.
impact: Could reject viable solutions or accept unphysical ones

title: Dynamic Constraint Evolution
description: Parameter constraints may evolve during warp bubble operation, but current analysis only considers static constraint satisfaction.
impact: Solutions may become unphysical during operation even if initially valid

title: Constraint Verification Computational Cost
description: Comprehensive constraint checking may be computationally prohibitive for real-time optimization or control applications.
impact: May need to use approximate constraints that could miss constraint violations
